ShortDescription.Value: Cheat and sandbox panel: money, milestones, demand, Force Build and more.

Publish.LongDescription:
A cheat and sandbox panel. Click the ◆ button in the top-left corner to open it.
Economy - Add or remove money, or infinite money - Jump to any milestone, or unlock them all - Development tree points
Build - Instant construction, or ½× to 4× build speed - Level up buildings, max efficiency - Fill storage, or keep it full
People - Boost move-ins and tourists (up to 10×) - Max happiness, rich citizens, max education
Demand - Set demand for each zone - Force Build: buildings spawn even with no demand or a poor lot
Also: panel colours, reset cheats on load, keep achievements on.
